test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 08 Feb 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Seven persons E, F, G, H, I, J and K are sitting in a straight line facing north. K sits third to the left of H. No one is sitting between F and I. H sits fourth to the right of J. No one is sitting to the right of I. F sits third to the right of E. Who is sitting third from the right end of the row?
solution:
**Given :** Seven persons E, F, G, H, I, J and K are sitting in a straight line facing north. 

**Explanation :**

1) No one is sitting to the right of I.

2) No one is sitting between F and I.

3) F sits third to the right of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/004bef0a88bfe1dd9811382f608e6a2ea5f1a3abd672adc4423b0db741c7fba5.png] 

4) H sits fourth to the right of J.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30ddfda2fe761b0c290e6d73bc636175c1938e81d3cdae4fde89eca18e824636.png] 

5) K sits third to the left of H.

After positioning K only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aff678f12c4376e67b2334fd8af5f93436a8a59634a7781a720acb625f6c1b2f.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement H is sitting third from the right end of the row.

Hence, **"H"** is the correct answer.
